::: {.content-block}

This site is generated from my publication record rather than written by hand.
The publication list, the per-paper pages and the [research
landscape](research_landscape.html) are all built from metadata fetched through
public APIs, so they stay current without anyone editing a bibliography.

## Where the metadata comes from

ORCID holds the authoritative list of works; everything else enriches it. Where
two sources disagree, each field records which one it came from.

| Source | What it contributes |
|---|---|
| [ORCID](https://orcid.org) | the list of works itself |
| [CrossRef](https://www.crossref.org) | authors, affiliations, journal, volume and pages |
| [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org) | open-access status and links, plus authors and abstracts where CrossRef has gaps |
| [Semantic Scholar](https://www.semanticscholar.org) | abstracts and TL;DR summaries |
| [doi2bib](https://www.doi2bib.org) | BibTeX entries |
| [Altmetric](https://www.altmetric.com) | the attention badge on each paper page |

## How the research landscape is built

Abstracts are lemmatized with [NLTK](https://www.nltk.org), embedded with the
`all-MiniLM-L6-v2` [sentence-transformers](https://sbert.net) model, projected
onto two dimensions with [UMAP](https://umap-learn.readthedocs.io) and clustered
into topics with [BERTopic](https://github.com/MaartenGr/BERTopic). Papers
without a usable abstract fall back to their title. The result is the scatter
plot on the [research landscape](research_landscape.html) page, and the topic
label attached to each paper.

## Tooling

The backend is written in Python with the
[my-scientific-profile](https://github.com/tbereau/my_scientific_profile)
library. The frontend uses [Quarto](https://quarto.org); the sortable tables and
the landscape plot are [Observable JS](https://quarto.org/docs/interactive/ojs/)
running in your browser, so no data leaves the page.

The source for this site lives at
[tbereau/tbereau](https://github.com/tbereau/tbereau).

## Analytics

Visits are counted with [GoatCounter](https://www.goatcounter.com), which sets
no cookies and does not track visitors across sites.

:::
